name: Vouch
long_description: Vouch is an AI-native wealth manager for India’s booming middle class. It makes investing and building wealth extremely simple for everyone: connect what you already own, share your goals, and Vouch takes care of the rest, from picking investments to cutting your tax bill. India will add $2.37 trillion in financial wealth by 2030, yet fewer than 1 in 10 Indians invest, and physical assets dominate. As the economy rapidly financializes, Vouch will be the one platform Indians use to manage all their money.
one_liner: The AI wealth manager for every Indian

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Vouch. Previously youngest PM at Robinhood to own a product line, leading 0 to 1 buildout of Advisor Network. Worked on trading engine optimization and ops at Jane Street. Penn CS grad.
